physiology:
The traditions seat this code at the navel, the soft middle of you, the part of the body that knew the world before the mouth did. It is the first knot, the first tie, the place a person was joined to something larger and then cut loose from it. Every later clinging has a memory of that one.

The shadow lives here as a small tight ring. The flutter when the phone rings at the wrong hour, the held breath halfway down, the cold pebble that settles a few inches below the ribs and stays. It is not a metaphor. The belly is where the news of impermanence is received first, and where the body, not knowing what else to do, grips. People walk around with that grip for years and call it their personality.

The climb out begins lower than thought. A long out-breath that does not get bargained with. The pebble warming. A loosening that is not decided on, it just turns up, the way light returns to a room you forgot was dark. From there the rearranging can start, the small inventive moves that the gift is made of, but they begin in a navel that has stopped bracing.

The code is seated where you were once fed without asking, and where you are still fed, by breath and by blood, while you do other things.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the organ, this code answers to a single amino acid, Leucine, one of the small set the body cannot make for itself. It must come in from outside, broken down at the table, before any of the rest can happen.

Leucine is the body's signal to build. It is the chemistry that tells a cell to grow, repair, lay down new tissue where the old has worn through. Nothing in you renews without it. The Ring of Life and Death runs on this single letter, the same letter in six different codes, the same instruction read six different ways.

There is a teaching in that. The code of difficult beginnings, of clinging and innovating and finally letting the grip go, runs all the way down to a chemistry of building and breaking down. The body is doing this work whether the mind is ready or not. Cells are being made and unmade in you while you read this. The card only asks that you stop interfering with what your chemistry has already agreed to.
